source.generatorPaper: Islam et al. 2022, Cell Genomics, DOI 10.1016/j.xgen.2022.100179
source.datasetDescription: SBS component of the published 2,700-sample benchmark: 300 simulated genomes for each of nine cancer types, generated from 21 COSMIC reference signatures. The archived COSMIC v3.3 GRCh37 matrix contains 78 signature columns; this archived shape is used without adding or imputing columns.

subset.method: 30 evenly spaced sample IDs per cancer type
